cardOverview.overviewText: A Prime Mastercard variant delivering premium lifestyle rewards, travel perks, and milestone bonuses for everyday spenders.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Get upto 25% discount on dining bills at partner restaurants (only with AmEx variant).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Explore the available dining and order-in offers, select your preferred meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% discount at participating restaurants. Complete the payment using your SBI Prime (SBI: Mastercard) credit card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary 4 rounds of green fee and 1 complimentary golf lesson every month and also upto 50% off on golf games (With MasterCard Variant only).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To place a golf game/ lesson request, please call 1800-102-6263. Further, for any queries under this golf program, you may write to the support email ID: mastercardindiagolf@apexlynx.net
